en.headline: Hong Kong holds 24th place in 2026 global Rule of Law Index
en.dek: The World Justice Project ranks the city sixth in East Asia and the Pacific, with order and security rising to seventh worldwide, the Department of Justice said.
body: Hong Kong ranked 24th out of 143 countries and jurisdictions in the World Justice Project’s 2026 Rule of Law Index and sixth in East Asia and the Pacific, the Department of Justice said on Wednesday.

The city’s overall scores in most categories were similar to last year. It remained in the global top 10 for absence of corruption and for order and security, with the latter rising to seventh place worldwide.

A government spokesman attributed the stronger order-and-security ranking to the successive implementation of the Hong Kong National Security Law, the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance and other related legislation, saying these measures had better protected the city’s security and sustained a favourable business environment.

Rankings for constraints on government powers and civil justice stayed the same as last year, while open government and regulatory enforcement were nearly unchanged. Rankings for fundamental rights and criminal justice declined slightly.

The spokesman said that under the “one country, two systems” principle and the Basic Law, Hong Kong maintains a robust legal framework for human-rights protection and an open judicial system in which the courts exercise independent judicial power free from interference.

The government said it would continue to uphold the rule of law, promote rule-of-law education and cultivate foreign-related legal talent while safeguarding national sovereignty, security and development interests.

zh.headline: 香港法治指數維持全球第24位 秩序與安全升至第7
zh.dek: 世界正義工程公布2026年指數，香港在東亞及太平洋區排第6，律政司指廉潔及秩序安全仍居全球十大。
body: 律政司周三表示，世界正義工程公布《2026年法治指數》，香港在143個國家和地區中排名第24位，東亞及太平洋地區則保持第6位。
政府發言人指出，本港在大部分領域得分與去年相若，廉潔以及秩序和安全範疇繼續位列全球十大，當中秩序和安全更上升至全球第7位。
發言人表示，這反映隨着《香港國安法》、《維護國家安全條例》及其他維護國家安全相關法律相繼實施，香港安全獲得更好保障，並持續具備優秀的營商和投資環境。
對政府權力的制約及民事司法排名與去年相同；開放政府及監管執法排名幾乎不變；基本權利及刑事司法排名則輕微下調。
發言人強調，在「一國兩制」及基本法保障下，香港擁有穩健的人權保障法律架構和開放的司法制度，司法機關依法獨立行使審判權，不受任何干涉。
特區政府表示，將繼續全方位維護法治，推展法治教育，培養涉外法律人才，並在法治軌道上維護國家主權、安全和發展利益。
